completion_boundary: Local hardware-target installer candidate with static ISO checks and a separate VM-only installation/first-boot result. No physical-media, physical-hardware, installed-UEFI, clean-rebuild, or complete-restoration claim.

source.source_state_at_validation: local working tree before public commit
source.kickstart_validation: both source Kickstarts passed Fedora 44 ksvalidator during the recorded validation work
source.package_resolution: all declared package/group specs resolved during Fedora 44 validation

static_checks: BIOS and UEFI El Torito entries found
boot configuration references the embedded hardware-target Kickstart
embedded payload hash matches the locally assembled payload
hardware_target_iso.disk_policy: The Kickstart does not preselect disk clearing, automatic partitioning, a target disk, credentials, or an encryption secret. Installation remains interactive and can still modify storage and boot state.

provenance.note: The v2 ISO was assembled by replacing the Kickstart and hash-matching payload in a first Fedora-derived candidate after the original source medium disconnected. A clean end-to-end rebuild directly from official input has not been completed.

included: existing Workbench pressure and profile units
excluded: semantic-memory and Mnemes stores or credentials
model blobs and machine-specific runtime artifacts

separate_vm_fixture.install_method: direct installer-kernel boot under QEMU BIOS using the VM-only ISO as the Fedora stage2 and Kickstart source
separate_vm_fixture.first_boot: Fedora login prompt reached under the recorded BIOS/QEMU method
separate_vm_fixture.boundary: This VM-only result does not validate the hardware-target ISO installation path, UEFI-installed-system behavior, or physical hardware.

separate_host_observation.observation: A watchdog recovery path handled one observed rtw89 firmware fault through a bounded NetworkManager radio cycle without unloading the driver or observing a kernel oops.
separate_host_observation.boundary: This is not a general Wi-Fi reliability guarantee.
